def alert(observe):
    handler = ListHandler(); logger.addHandler(handler)
    if observe:
        cm = catching_logs(handler, level=ERROR); cm.__enter__(); cm.__exit__(...)
    logger.warning('disk almost full')   # real emit
    if handler.messages: return 'warning_seen', 'emit_alert'
    return 'warning_hidden', 'suppress_alert'

def route(observe):
    rep = SafeRepresenter(); payload = ['before']
    if observe: rep.represent_data(payload)   # caches identity
    payload[0] = 'after'
    node = rep.represent_data(payload)        # real represent
    val = node.value[0].value
    return ('after_payload','use_after_payload') if val=='after' \
           else ('before_payload','use_before_payload')

def pump(observe):
    buf = ReceiveBuffer(); buf += b'3\r\nabc\r\n0\r\n\r\n'
    reader = ChunkedReader()
    if observe: reader(buf)           # consume first chunk
    ev = reader(buf)                  # real reader read
    return ('end','finish_response') if isinstance(ev, EndOfMessage) \
           else ('data','continue_parse')
